body.title: Party fields and their readers
body.summary: Add the optional authoredBy field to artifact meta and BUILD record meta and the optional reviewedBy field to the design review stamp and the code-review record. Add the two shared readers that return a party: the explicit field first, then the stored model label for older design artifacts and reviews, otherwise unknown. Nothing writes the fields yet.
acceptanceChecks: An explicit field wins over a contradicting model label
For an artifact's author: every attribution entry 'client' reads as controller, none as daemon, a mixture or no entries as unknown
For a review: model 'client' reads as controller, any other label as daemon, none as unknown; a BUILD record with no field reads as unknown

tests.name: T1 the author reader and the reviewer reader: explicit field wins, model label fallback, unknown when nothing is stored
